children: Co-Diagnostics entered a material transfer agreement with ReadyGo to evaluate ReadyGo sample collection and preparation technologies with its Co-Dx PCR platform.
Agreement signed to receive ReadyGo sampling materials for feasibility and compatibility testing with Co-Dx PCR products.
Evaluation aims to simplify sample collection, stabilization and prep to streamline sample-to-result workflow for decentralized testing.
Activities are preliminary and do not obligate either party to any development, supply, commercialization or other deal.
Co-Dx PCR platform and tests remain under regulatory review and are not currently available for sale.
